verdict.rationale: Relay's marketing says you can issue Visa debit or credit cards to team members (up to 50 virtual or physical), set spend limits, define roles, and track transactions in real time. Support docs add instant card freezing, and role-based team access is documented. Community notes on minor permission and limit glitches are not concrete contradictions, and the platform-wide $7,000 daily cap is a fixed ceiling rather than a user-set control. Missing for 10: step-by-step docs for setting limits on an individual card, granular controls beyond limits and roles (e.g. merchant/category restrictions, per-employee policies), independent hands-on confirmation of per-card limit setting.
